mapper.sql: select order_id, out_trade_no, user_id, product_id, product_type, product_name, amount_cent, credits, member_tier, member_days, status, transaction_id, prepay_id, paid_time, expire_time, notify_time, raw_notify, create_time, update_time from ai_payment_order
mapper.insert: insert into ai_payment_order( out_trade_no, user_id, product_id, product_type, product_name, amount_cent, credits, member_tier, member_days, status, expire_time, create_time ) values ( #{outTradeNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productType}, #{productName}, #{amountCent}, #{credits}, #{memberTier}, #{memberDays}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update ai_payment_order set prepay_id = #{prepayId}, update_time = sysdate() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

update ai_payment_order set status = 'PAID', transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_time = #{paidTime}, notify_time = sysdate(), raw_notify = #{rawNotify}, update_time = sysdate() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and status != 'PAID'
mapper.select: select user_id, member_tier, addon_bonus, expire_time, create_time, update_time from ai_user_membership where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_user_membership set member_tier = #{memberTier}, addon_bonus = #{addonBonus}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
